newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Evergreen adds 280K TEU container capacity.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Evergreen adds 280K TEU container capacity.

text.p: Taiwan shipping group Evergreen Marine Corp (Taiwan) Ltd said on Monday it would buy 280,000 TEUs of container capacity for over T$870 million from its subsidiary Evergreen Heavy Industrial Co.
Evergreen Heavy Industrial's Taiwan and Malaysia branch would build the containers to a range of specifications, an Evergreen Marine official said.
Evergreen Marine's board approved the purchase on December 14, the official added.
Evergreen, one of the world's largest shipping concerns, has said it wants to expand its fleet to capture the growing container market worldwide.
